title: THE TRIP
logline: The inciting invitation. A name is spoken over a loudspeaker: AARANYA RIDGE OBSERVATORY. The story's door opens.
grade: Cool, dusty, high-ceilinged. Sunlight through tall windows in visible shafts. The only saturated colour in the hall is the projection screen.

narration.hi: अगले हफ़्ते की सुबह असेंबली में एक नाम आया — आरण्य रिज ऑब्ज़र्वेटरी।
narration.en: The following week, in assembly, a name came over the speakers — Aaranya Ridge Observatory.

narration.hi: तीन दिन का एजुकेशनल ट्रिप। पहाड़, दूरबीनें, और स्कूल से दूर दो रातें। कबीर की आँखों में चिंगारी थी। मेरी भी थी।
narration.en: A three-day educational trip. Mountains, telescopes, and two nights away from school. There was a spark in Kabir's eyes. In mine too.

shots.cam: Interior, height 2.20 m on a riser at the back of the hall, centred on the stage
shots.move: Slow 10° drift left to reveal the full room.
shots.action: Rows of students in uniform, a few whispering, one teacher at the microphone; the projection screen is still white.
shots.env: L07 assembly hall: raked floor, stage with a wooden podium, tall windows on the RIGHT wall, ceiling fans, a projector hanging from the centre truss.
shots.light: Overcast daylight through the tall windows: soft directional shafts, dust suspended; house lights off.
shots.cont: CROWD LOCK: assembly is a different crowd from the classroom — vary faces, but no character from the main cast wears a different uniform. Ever.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.70 m, on the stage, 3/4 side on the teacher at the podium
shots.move: Static; she looks from her notes to the room.
shots.action: She taps the mic twice, checks a paper, and gestures toward the screen. Her lips move — no audio.
shots.expr: Friendly but disciplined: a slight smile, then straight back to business.
shots.env: Podium, a glass of water, a stack of permission forms, the microphone stand.
shots.light: Stage key from a high side window; her shadow falls back-left onto the curtains.
shots.cont: TEACHER LOCK: 30s, glasses, navy saree with a plain border, hair in a low bun, ID lanyard. Same as S06 but formal saree, not classroom saree. Do not give her a name.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.90 m, projector lens level, framed so only the screen fills the frame
shots.move: Static; three slow slide changes on a 4 s dissolve each.
shots.action: Slides: (1) a dome observatory on a ridge at dawn, (2) a long-exposure star field, (3) students looking through a telescope.
shots.env: Projection surface only: cool white, faint hotspot in the centre.
shots.light: The screen is the light source for this shot — project a soft glow onto the surrounding darkness.
shots.vfx: Projector dust, a faint horizontal scan shimmer. Keep it analogue and period-honest.
shots.vo: Silence. Let the audience read the photographs.
shots.cont: The dome in slide 1 MUST match the architecture revealed in S11 (A-11): white ribbed dome, single slit, ridge on the left. Continuity supervisor to compare frames.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.55 m, from the stage looking down at the front rows — reverse angle to S08-01
shots.move: Slow 20° pan right across the faces.
shots.action: Heads turning to each other; a ripple of excitement; one student actually bounces in his seat.
shots.expr: Uncontained teenage excitement, in 60 different shades.
shots.env: Front six rows, wooden seats, backpacks on laps.
shots.light: Cool ambient; faces lit from the front by the screen reflection — a moving blue-white key.
shots.vfx: Screen-reflected flicker on faces, extremely subtle.
shots.cont: Meera is in the third row, Ishaan and Kabir in the fifth. Keep them separated here — the bus reunites them.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.45 m, seated eye level, 3/4 on Kabir
shots.move: Static. Small 1-px shake only when he grabs Ishaan's arm.
shots.action: His face lights up two beats before he moves; then he turns and grabs Ishaan's forearm with both hands.
shots.expr: The full grin. Mouth open, eyes wide, dimple deep. This is Kabir's best frame in the episode.
shots.env: Seated rows, shoulders of other students framing him.
shots.light: Screen light from frame-left, warm bounce from Ishaan's jacket on the right.
shots.cont: His sweater-vest sleeve must be visible — he never wears a jacket.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.50 m, in front of them at bench height, looking back
shots.move: Static; a 15° correction to keep the teacher's glare in frame-right.
shots.action: The boys whisper furiously and bump fists under the seat. The teacher's head turns; they freeze instantly into identical innocent postures.
shots.expr: Panic-comedy. Identical straight faces, one bead of sweat on Kabir.
shots.env: Assembly seating, foreground teacher shoulder out of focus.
shots.cont: PROPOSED (non-canon): the fist bump and the freeze. It's a genre beat, not a plot event.

shots.cam: Interior, height 2.30 m, wide from the back of the hall as the room reacts
shots.move: Slow crane up 0.8 m over the shot — the room opening like a held breath.
shots.action: A visible wave of excitement moves through the hall; students turn to each other; the teacher raises a hand for quiet, smiling.
shots.light: Overcast shafts; the projector is now dark, so the room dims by a stop and the shafts dominate.
shots.vo: Line 2 ends at 20:04; 90 s of wordless school life before Scene 9.
shots.cont: End the scene on the hall, not on a face — the pull of the destination must feel bigger than the characters.
